task.description:
WF-03 FAST-TRACK: Two targeted fixes from UAT v5.

Fix 1 (MAJOR) — OidcCallbackPage does not populate tenant context after OIDC code exchange:
After signinRedirectCallback() succeeds, OidcCallbackPage must populate tenant_slug and tenant_display_name in the session.
Look at how AuthProvider.tsx does it after login (it calls resolveTenantSlug + fetchTenantConfig + sets session fields). OidcCallbackPage must do the same after the code exchange.

Read OidcCallbackPage.tsx first to understand the current flow:
1. It calls getOidcManager() → signinRedirectCallback()
2. On success it gets a UserResult → calls setSession()
3. BUG: it calls setSession() WITHOUT tenant_slug/tenant_display_name, so they default to null

Fix: After successful callback, before calling setSession():
  const config = await fetchTenantConfig(window.location.hostname) // or use resolveRealmFromUrl
  const slug = config.oidc_authority comes from swiftroute realm → extract slug from oidc_authority
  const tenantResp = await tenantsApi.getBySlug(slug)
  then include tenant_slug and tenant_display_name in setSession() call

Actually: the slug is already in sessionStorage['bpm_realm_slug'] from the ISS-0072 fix (resolveRealmFromUrl writes it there). So the fix is:
  const realmSlug = resolveRealmFromUrl() || sessionStorage.getItem('bpm_realm_slug')
  if (realmSlug) {
    const tenantData = await tenantsApi.getBySlug(realmSlug).catch(() => null)
    // then add tenant_slug: realmSlug, tenant_display_name: tenantData?.display_name ?? null to setSession
  }

Fix 2 (MINOR) — Pipeline test display_name env var:
In web/tests/e2e/pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts:
Add two more env var constants near INJECTED_SLUG:
  const INJECTED_DISPLAY_NAME   = process.env.ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_DISPLAY_NAME
  const INJECTED_ADMIN_DISPLAY  = process.env.ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_ADMIN_DISPLAY_NAME
Update the form fills for #display_name and #admin_display_name to use injected values with fallback:
  await page.locator('#display_name').fill(INJECTED_DISPLAY_NAME ?? `Pipeline Tenant ${uid}`)
  await page.locator('#admin_display_name').fill(INJECTED_ADMIN_DISPLAY ?? `PL Admin ${uid}`)

Branch workflow:
  git checkout main
  git pull --ff-only origin main
  git checkout -b feature/WF03-oidc-session-tenant-20260616
  git push origin feature/WF03-oidc-session-tenant-20260616

After implementation:
  python tools/lint_frontend_conventions.py web/src (exits 0)
  cd web && npm run type-check (exits 0)
  cd web && npm run lint (exits 0)
  cd web && npm run build (exits 0)

Commit:
  git add -A
  git commit -m 'fix(WF03): populate tenant context after OIDC callback + display_name injection (ISS-0074)'
  git push origin feature/WF03-oidc-session-tenant-20260616

Then: rebase, create PR, squash-merge, delete branch.
  PR title: 'fix(WF03): tenant context populated in OIDC callback + pipeline display_name injection (ISS-0074)'
  gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
  git checkout main
  git pull --ff-only origin main
